English fluent

title: Strategic Operations Analyst
description:
Job Post: Strategic Operations Analyst

Full-Time | Associate / Analyst Level

Department: Strategic Solutions

About the Role:

We are looking for a Strategic Operations Analyst to join our Strategic Solutions Department. This role is key to driving internal efficiency, strengthening data integrity, and enhancing cross-departmental collaboration. You’ll act as a strategic enabler and systems observer, ensuring that our CRM/PRM tools are used effectively to generate insights and support long-term planning.

If you are analytical, process-minded, and proactive in maintaining high-quality internal data, this role is for you.

Key Responsibilities:

Strategic Intelligence & PRM/CRM Oversight

  • Monitor CRM/PRM data to detect gaps in client engagement history.
  • Follow up with Sales Directors and team members to ensure accurate data logging.
  • Analyze CRM/PRM data to identify trends, support reporting, and generate strategic insights.

Cross-Functional Process Understanding

  • Map and document workflows across departments.
  • Observe meetings and shadow teams to identify silos and inefficiencies.
  • Recommend improvements to drive clarity, redundancy, or cross-training.

Strategic Support & Insights

  • Support leadership with initiatives like client segmentation, performance reviews, and market analysis.
  • Extract and present data for strategic decision-making.
  • Maintain a log of observations, bottlenecks, and actionable suggestions.

Documentation & Reporting

  • Keep SOPs and internal process documents up-to-date.
  • Deliver recurring summaries with data quality status, key insights, and recommendations.
  • Contribute to quarterly presentations and strategic overviews.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Economics, Engineering, or a related field.
  • 1–3 years of experience in business analysis, sales operations, or internal consulting.
  • Fluent in English
  • Strong analytical and critical thinking skills.
  • Excellent communication and follow-up skills—especially with senior stakeholders.
  • Ability to navigate cross-functional environments and competing priorities.
  • Proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint; BI tools a plus.

title: Senior Information Technology Business Analyst
description:

Atos is a global leader in digital transformation with c. 78,000 employees and annual revenue of c. € 10 billion. description:
Olá, nós somos a Odebrecht Engenharia & Construção.

Fazemos parte do Grupo Novonor e atuamos, principalmente, no Brasil, Angola e Estados Unidos.

Temos mais de 80 anos de história, destes, 40 anos atuando em Angola, e nosso propósito é contribuir para a construção de um futuro sustentável, servindo à sociedade por meio da capacidade transformadora de nossa engenharia, acreditando e desenvolvendo profissionais locais para a realização do sonho dos nossos clientes.

Todos os dias, nos diversos países que atuamos, buscamos fornecer soluções para alguns dos maiores desafios do mundo - como educação, saúde, energia, água, transporte, habitação e saneamento.

Ao longo dos quase 40 anos de atuação em Angola, a Odebrecht cria e implementa programas que enriquecem as comunidades, apostando fortemente na criação de emprego, na formação de cidadãos angolanos e no desenvolvimento econômico e social do país.

title: Gerente de Operações
description:
Descrição:

Gerenciar equipe e supervisionar a realização das atividades da área, elaborando relatórios de controle e monitoramento, prestando assistência aos parceiros comerciais, acompanhando auditorias externas, conduzindo a equipe nos processos de entrega e devolução de quiosques, realizando análise de viabilidade de captação de novos produtos e parceiros, bem como fortalecendo o relacionamento com os operadores, visando garantir a prestação de serviços de qualidade aos clientes.

Atribuições:

  • Promover avaliação periódica da equipe, através da análise dos relatórios de produtividade, prestando feedbacks semanais, a fim de acompanhar o desempenho, identificar oportunidades de melhoria e auxiliar no desenvolvimento dos colaboradores.
  • Prestar assistência aos parceiros Comerciais, coordenando o acompanhamento das faltas e/ou intercorrências de produtos, para monitoramento do cumprimento dos contratos.
  • Acompanhar mensalmente a auditoria externa (Contrato Ambev), presencialmente, prestando informações e auxílio aos auditores, para cumprimento de cláusulas contratuais e conferência do mix obrigatório de produtos nos quiosques.
  • Efetuar fechamento de Auditoria (Contrato Ambev), após a auditoria realizar conferência dos arquivos referentes, a fim de enviar à Ambev e ao setor Financeiro para encerramento do processo e emissão das notas fiscais para pagamento.
  • Acompanhar auditoria diária dos quiosques, através da agenda de visitas dos consultores e reporte do Supervisor, para conferência do cumprimento dos contratos.
  • Elaborar relatórios de controle operacional mensal ou mediante demanda elencando todas as atividades e resultados do departamento, incluindo evidências fotográficas de status dos quiosques se necessário, enviando os dados para acompanhamento pela diretoria.
  • Promover/participar de reuniões com outros departamentos (Atendimento ao Cliente, Manutenção, Auditoria, Postos e Bases, Comercial, Merchandising) conforme agendamento mensal, semanal ou de urgência específica, para alinhamento de andamento de processos, troca de ideias, resolução de problemas e definição de planos de ação.
  • Realizar estudo de viabilidade de novos produtos e/ou parceiros, analisando juntamente com o departamento de atendimento ao cliente, visando trazer maiores resultados aos clientes.
  • Acompanhar relatórios sanitários, conforme reporte da equipe de sanitaristas, para monitoramento das atividades realizadas e do desempenho de cada quiosque.
  • Promover/participar de reuniões com novos operadores, através de agendamento prévio, visando alinhamento de execução do plano de ação inicial operacional onde são dispostas as principais demandas e obrigatoriedades do operador.
  • Garantir cadastro de novos clientes efetuando o processo junto aos operadores via sistema Check List, para obter os dados necessários para firmar novos parceiros e ações.
  • Acompanhar equipe nas inaugurações e entrega de quiosques, por meio de visitas agendadas com operadores e departamentos responsáveis, garantindo o preenchimento de relatórios e termos pertinentes, a fim de criar comunicação efetiva com o cliente e garantir a qualidade das entregas.
  • Atuar junto à equipe nas devoluções de quiosques, por meio de visitas agendadas com o operador e departamento de Manutenção, assegurando o preenchimento de checklist de vistoria e o termo de devolução de posse assinado, para documentar o estado do quiosque na data, bem como obter evidências para realizar cobrança de itens que não estiverem em conformidade.
  • Fechar penalidades de todos os contratos que geram receita para a empresa, via sistema Totvs, para que o financeiro faça o fechamento contábil das receitas da empresa.
  • Cadastrar amarração de contratos Ambev via sistema Totvs, para identificação dos clientes correspondentes para posterior fechamento de penalidades (auxiliando o departamento Jurídico), para garantir que o setor Financeiro efetue o fechamento contábil da referida empresa.
  • Promover reuniões/treinamentos mensais a equipe, abordando temas como: comunicação, relacionamento com cliente e ética profissional, visando orientar e desenvolver para obter melhor performance dos colaboradores e uma gestão mais eficiente.
  • Promover a integração entre os operadores e a empresa, realizando reuniões semanais, visando manter um relacionamento de feedback essencial para proporcionar melhoria na prestação de serviços.
  • Coordenar implantação dos projetos, montagem e execução de operações externas, realizando estudo da viabilidade através da análise do objetivo do cliente, visando garantir entregas de qualidade para os operadores.
  • Acompanhar auditoria e controle financeiro do Contrato Souza Cruz, realizando acompanhamento das vendas, levantamento e cobrança aos operadores das dívidas e envio de fechamento mensal do contrato, para cumprimento das cláusulas contratuais da parceria comercial.
  • Elaborar relatórios semanais de acompanhamento de obras, através das fotos enviadas pela equipe e contato com os operadores e demais setores, para monitorar a execução de obras nos quiosques.

Requisitos:

  • Ensino superior completo em Administração, Engenharias, Publicidade e Propagando ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência entre 3 a 5 anos na área;
  • Ter disponibilidade para atuar em campo;
  • Ter CNH B;
  • Ter experiência com o sistema Totvs.

Escala e local de trabalho:

Segunda à sexta-feira – 8h às 17:48 (Com 1h de almoço) | Zona Sul.

Contrato CLT – Salário a combinar (enviar pretensão salarial).

Experiência com Ambientes Multi-cloud (OCI e AWS) e suas ferramentas de gestão e automação.
Sólida experiência em SRE, DevOps ou Engenharia de Produção em ambientes de missão crítica;
Domínio em práticas de observabilidade: métricas, logs, tracing e alertas (ex: Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana, etc);
Conhecimento avançado em automação e IaC (Terraform, Ansible, CDK ou semelhantes);

Experiência com containers e orquestração (Docker, Kubernetes, ECS, EKS);
Boa base em sistemas distribuídos, redes, escalabilidade e gerenciamento de capacidade;
Mentalidade “you build it, you run it”, com foco em confiabilidade e colaboração entre times.
Diferenciais
Certificações relevantes (ex: Google SRE, AWS DevOps Engineer, Kubernetes CKA/CKS);
Experiência em ambientes com cultura de SRE madura (SLIs/SLOs, toil reduction, etc);
Vivência com testes de caos e engenharia de resiliência (Chaos Monkey, Gremlin);
Capacidade de análise de custos operacionais e otimização de uso da infraestrutura;
Experiência com automação de testes de performance e de carga;

Para nós, educação é um ato de liberdade.
Ensinar um idioma é algo que muda a vida das pessoas por criar possibilidade que antes não existiam e oferece a coragem de escolher novos caminhos que antes eram inimagináveis, permitindo que sonhem sonhos nunca antes sonhados.
Essa é a nossa missão no mundo, e essa será a sua missão ao se juntar a nós.
Aqui, aprender vai além do conteúdo acadêmico – nossa metodologia conecta você ao mundo e cria novas oportunidades.

Estes são nossos valores e princípios:
Não ser igual a todo mundo;
Seguir a nossa matemática do sucesso;
Sonhar alto e corremos na frente
Empreender e aprendemos
Ensinar e transformar pessoas
Focar no resultado
Saber fazer
Respeito & Confiança
Comunicar com Clareza e Simplicidades;
Ser rápido, mas sem pressa.
Quer entender mais a fundo esses princípios, e como colocamos isso em prática?
Cadastre-se em nossas vagas em aberto.

Estamos procurando um Consultor de Campo em Vendas para se juntar à nossa equipe de Implantação de Franquias.
Este cargo é focado em realizar visitas de campo para apoiar e acompanhar a performance de nossas franquias.
Sua vivência será dentro das Escolas KNN, liderando a implantação de novas unidades fraqueadas.
Você desempenha o papel de um Gerente Comercial, e serve como exemplo e inspiração para a Equipe Comercial da nova escola.
Além disso, para a área Comercial, você é o braço direito do Novo Franqueado(a), ajudando essa pessoa a fazer a colocar em prática todos os ensinamentos do Treinamento de Franqueados.
Nunca desempenhou esse papel?
Sem problemas! Na KNN contratamos além da experiência, mas sim por perfil cultural.
Você será treinado durante 6 meses pelos nossos de especialistas do Time de Implantação e do Time de Suporte Comercial.

de um
Consultor de Campo em Vendas
incluem:
Criar um
Plano de Ação para abertura e inauguração
da nova Escola;
Recrutar e Selecionar uma equipe comercial
para a nova Escola;
Treinar a Equipe Comercial
com base nas práticas comerciais de uma Escola KNN, mais especificamente disseminando a
Teoria Comercial KNN.
Implementar estratégias de vendas , colocando em práticas as
Campanhas Comerciais e Ações de Externo .
Matricular novos alunos
para comprovar a eficácia da Teoria Comercial KNN;
Treinar o novo Franqueado
com base na Rotina Gerencial Comercial;
Acompanhar indicadores de desempenho da unidade
e ajustar a rota com base no Plano de Ação criado;

Necessário possuir experiência em vendas e habilidade em desenvolver e implementar estratégias eficazes.
Treinamento e Desenvolvimento:
Habilidade para realizar treinamentos de equipes de vendas, promovendo capacitação e melhor desempenho.

Conhecimento em acompanhar e analisar indicadores de desempenho para identificar áreas de melhoria.

Postura profissional e
excelente comunicação interpessoal;
Proatividade, autogerenciamento
e alto poder de motivação própria e de terceiros;
Capacidade de convencer e influenciar pessoas;
Comprometimento com resultados

Flexibilidade para viagens

Habilidade para lidar com diferentes perfis e culturas organizacionais;

Proficiency with issue tracking and test management tools (e.g., JIRA, TestRail).
Working knowledge of
Postman
for API testing and basic QA automation concepts.
Excellent analytical skills, attention to detail, and clear documentation abilities.
Comfortable working in agile, iterative development environments.

in Product Management for B2B SaaS, and business software development.

author detailed PRDs
, story maps, wireframes, and acceptance tests.

osso Jeito:​N

About Nosso Futebol:
Nosso Futebol, part of Sporty Group, is a comprehensive sports broadcasting platform based in Brazil, delivering over 400 live football matches per year. We have distribution agreements with leading local Pay TV operators and a growing digital presence. We are rapidly becoming Brazil’s most dynamic football broadcaster, the home of Série C, select Série B and Bundesliga matches, regional tournaments, the European League of Football (ELF), and women’s football, with new content and offerings launched regularly.
Role Overview:
As a Traffic Analyst at Nosso Futebol, you will be responsible for ensuring the proper scheduling and execution of the channel’s programming and commercial breaks. Controls all materials scheduled for broadcast, checking their availability, technical quality, and correct naming.
Ensures the receipt of CRTs and/or other necessary documentation.
Performs last-minute operational adjustments as requested by the Programming Coordination team.
In collaboration with the transmission coordinator, ensures the execution of the programming instruction (PI) during live events in the event of failures, delays, or emergency changes.
Collects and organizes data related to commercial airings.
Requirements:
Fluent in both English/Portuguese, with excellent communication skills.
Previous experience in Traffic, Broadcast Scheduling, or Media Operations;
Familiarity with playout systems and scheduling tools;
High attention to detail, reliability, and ability to work under pressure;
Strong communication skills and team-oriented mindset;
Basic technical understanding of video formats and broadcast standards;
Proficiency in Excel and strong organizational skills for managing materials and reports;

Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você .

Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma.

Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.

Aqui você é mais que um professor.

uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.

não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.
Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.
Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a
ii
com certeza é o seu lugar.
Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas.
Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!

Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados

Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.

Strong attention to detail, logical thinking, and agility in handling real-time adjustments;
Good communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively with technical and operational teams;
Basic understanding of audience metrics and content performance indicators;
Proficiency in Excel and tools for content organization and control;

If you thrive on performance data, love solving ROAS puzzles, and know how to build and scale high-converting campaigns on Google and YouTube, this could be your next big move.
We’re looking for a strategic thinker who can own and scale a multi-million-dollar search engine account. You’ll be responsible for campaign strategy, performance optimization, and growing Google ad spend into the multi-millions, while launching YouTube as a standalone acquisition channel.
This isn’t a plug-and-play role. We want someone who owns results, makes decisive moves, and isn’t afraid to be accountable for outcomes. If you need step-by-step direction or shy away from taking full responsibility, this isn’t the role for you.

Budget Management & Channel Scaling
Manage and optimize a $600K/month Google Ads engine, with ~$500K allocated to Search and Performance Max.
Take ownership of scaling Google ad spend from six figures to multi-millions while maintaining strong performance metrics.
Build and grow YouTube as its own high-performing acquisition channel, developing a strategy tailored to its unique strengths.
Ensure efficient budget allocation across campaigns, balancing aggressive growth with disciplined ROI targets.
Forecast performance, scale winners, and pull back on underperformers with confidence and speed.
Campaign Strategy & Execution
Own the full lifecycle of Google and YouTube ad campaigns—from planning and launch to optimization and scaling.
Execute both search and video strategies using Google Ads and YouTube Ads Manager.
Set up advanced audience targeting, keyword strategies, bidding models, and exclusions.
Build and manage campaigns across multiple products and funnels, ensuring high efficiency and profitability.
Performance Optimization
Analyze campaign data daily to identify trends, diagnose performance issues, and uncover opportunities.
Optimize key metrics including CTR, CPC, ROAS, conversion rate, and CPA.
Rapidly test and iterate on creatives, headlines, calls to action, and landing page combinations.
Collaborate with our creative team to brief and test new video and static assets.
Creative & Funnel Collaboration
Partner with the creative team to ensure video scripts and visuals are optimized for YouTube’s first 5 seconds and beyond.
Provide feedback on hooks, visual pacing, and CTA integration based on performance data.
Align paid traffic with appropriate landing pages, upsells, and conversion paths.
Industry Knowledge
Stay current on platform updates, policy changes, and new ad formats for Google and YouTube.
Bring new strategies, trends, and tactics to the table that keep us ahead of the competition.
Requirements
5+ years running paid Google and/or YouTube campaigns
Proven experience managing a minimum of $1 million dollars of ad spend in Google and YouTube
Proven experience growing ad spend
Proven track record of scaling performance with ROAS and CAC accountability
Deep understanding of Google Ads platform, YouTube Ads, and audience segmentation
Strong data literacy and ability to interpret performance metrics to drive decision-making
Experience with attribution models and tracking setups (GA4, UTMs, etc.)

Self-starter who thrives in a fast-paced, data-driven environment

Willingness to work US time zones, regardless of geographic location.
Access to a computer

This is a full-time, remote contractor role that is open to international candidates. Pay is competitive and based on experience, skill level, and geographic location.

title: Senior Project Manager (Software Development)
description:
For Brazil Only, PJ contract, Fluent English
Job Title: Senior Project Manager (Software Development)
Type:
Full-Time or Part-time
Position Summary:
LOGIC Solutions Group is seeking a highly experienced Senior Project Manager to lead and manage projects with teams of Technical Architects, Developers, QA professionals, and Business Analysts in the geospatial information technology area. The ideal candidate will possess outstanding client communication skills, strong leadership capabilities, a deep understanding of Agile methodologies, and PMP certification. Additionally, the role requires hands-on experience managing projects through Microsoft DevOps, focusing on the effective organization and tracking of user stories, epics, sprints, and other Agile artifacts. The ability to perform business analysis as needed is also essential, ensuring that projects align with business and technical objectives.
Key Responsibilities:
Leadership & Team Management:
Lead and manage cross-functional teams, including Technical Architects, Developers, QA, and Business Analysts, ensuring high performance and alignment with project goals.
Provide mentorship and guidance to team members, fostering a collaborative and innovative work environment.
Oversee the team's daily operations, ensuring tasks are completed on time and within scope.
Project Management:
Develop, maintain, and execute detailed project plans, schedules, and budgets.
Ensure projects are delivered on time, within budget, and to the highest quality standards.
Manage multiple projects simultaneously, with a focus on application/software development.
Own and facilitate project status meetings, adjusting project targets and schedules as needed.
Microsoft DevOps Project Management:
Manage and configure sprints, backlogs, and work items within Microsoft DevOps to ensure project transparency and alignment with Agile methodologies.
Track and manage user stories and epics, ensuring they are well-defined, prioritized, and aligned with project goals.
Facilitate daily stand-ups (scrums), sprint planning, and sprint retrospectives to ensure team collaboration and continuous improvement.
Monitor and manage burndown charts and other Agile metrics to track project progress and ensure timely delivery.
Collaborate with team members to ensure DevOps practices support efficient project execution and align with client needs.
Business Analysis:
Perform business analysis tasks on projects as needed, including requirements gathering, process mapping, and stakeholder interviews.
Ensure business requirements are clearly defined, documented, and communicated to technical teams.
Client Engagement:
Serve as clients' primary point of contact, ensuring their needs and expectations are met.
Communicate project progress, risks, and issues effectively to clients and stakeholders.
Ensure client satisfaction by delivering projects that meet or exceed their requirements.
Technical Oversight:
Collaborate with Technical Architects to ensure project designs align with business objectives and technical standards.
Review and approve technical and business documentation, ensuring completeness and accuracy.
Stay updated on industry trends and emerging technologies to provide strategic technical direction.
Quality Assurance & Risk Management:
Implement quality control processes to ensure deliverables meet the required standards.
Identify and mitigate project risks, ensuring proactive solutions to potential challenges.
Required Skills & Experience:
Fluent English
Bachelor's Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Administration, or a closely related field.
Minimum of 8 years of IT Project Management experience in an Agile (Scrum) environment, with a strong focus on application/software development.
PMP certification is required.
Proven track record of managing teams of Technical Architects, Developers, QA professionals, and Business Analysts.
Hands-on experience with Microsoft DevOps, particularly in managing user stories, epics, sprints, and Agile metrics such as burndown charts.
Ability to perform business analysis on projects, including requirements gathering and process documentation.
Experience managing project budgets of over $1M and delivering projects on time and within scope.
Hands-on experience overseeing all phases of the SDLC, from requirements gathering to deployment.
Exceptional communication skills, both verbal and written, with the ability to convey technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
Strong leadership and team management skills, with a proven ability to motivate and guide cross-functional teams.
Strong organization skills and mindset.
Desired Skills & Qualifications:
Experience in the Oil and Gas industry is highly desirable.
Experience with geospatial technologies is a plus.
Previous experience in a consulting role or possessing a consultative mindset.
Prior hands-on development or coding experience is a plus.
Other:
The role offers a dynamic work environment with opportunities to work on cutting-edge technologies and solutions.
The successful candidate will be proactive, detail-oriented, and able to thrive in a fast-paced environment.
Informations:
Type of Contract:
PJ
Hours:
Full-time or Part-time
Location:
100% Remote
Start Date:
Immediate
Duration:
Long-term

Venha construir o futuro com a gente!​

Valorizamos um jeito de trabalhar simples e descomplicado, que realmente gera impacto positivo na vida das pessoas. Aqui, incentivamos o trabalho em equipe e a troca de ideias, pois acreditamos que é assim que crescemos juntos, tanto como profissionais quanto como pessoas.​

Nosso propósito é re solver a vida das pessoas,
de maneira simples e descomplicada, guiada por valores autênticos e que representem a nossa gente. Buscamos entregar resultados com integridade, sempre servindo o cliente da melhor forma; priorizamos a conveniência em cada experiência, seja nas lojas, no site ou no coração de milhões de famílias; valorizamos a pluralidade e a resiliência, além de reconhecer e cuidar das nossas pessoas. title: Power BI Engineer
description:
We are a high-growth, disruptive company combining gold and technology. Our vision is to help the world rediscover honest money. The successful candidate brings significant skills to help propel us forward on our mission.

Data Modeling & Querying

Develop, optimize, and maintain DAX calculations, measures, and KPIs.
Security & Governance
Implement Row-Level Security (RLS) or other relevant Power BI security features to protect sensitive data.
Work with management teams to ensure adherence to data governance and regulatory requirements.
Performance Tuning & Troubleshooting
Optimize Power BI data models, queries, and measures for performance and scalability.
Diagnose and resolve report rendering and data refresh performance issues.
Collaboration & Stakeholder Engagement
Partner with business stakeholders to gather requirements and deliver actionable reports and insights.
Provide training, documentation, and support to end-users and other internal teams.
Continuous Improvement
Stay current with emerging Power BI capabilities, DAX best practices, SQL performance enhancements, and analytics trends.
Contribute to the development of best practices for analytics, data governance, and solution design.

Experience:
3+ years
of professional experience with Power BI development, including data modeling, Power Query, and DAX.
Strong SQL proficiency , including complex joins, stored procedures, and performance tuning.

Power BI : Data modeling, DAX, Power Query M.
SQL : SQL, query optimization, data warehousing concepts.

(e.g., Git) and CI/CD pipelines for BI solutions (a plus).

Row-Level Security
and other Power BI security features.
Experience with
Azure Data Services
(e.g., Azure Synapse, Azure Analysis Services) is a plus.

Strong communication skills to collaborate with stakeholders and translate technical findings into actionable insights.

At YipitData, our legal team is an essential and collaborative partner in the Company’s growth. As

We expect Eastern Time work hours for this position.
As Our Counsel, Commercial Contracts You Will:
Develop contract negotiation and drafting skills to manage a wide variety of commercial matters for YipitData, including contracts with vendors, partners, and customers.
Learn in a rapidly changing environment by navigating new problems and conceiving novel contracting frameworks when needed.
Respond promptly to legal requests from Sales, Finance, Product, Marketing, Human Resources, and other internal clients to facilitate contract review, support their business needs and communicate legal issues in clear and concise terms.
Enhance processes, efficiency, and best practices, including ongoing improvements to contract templates and contract management processes.
Evaluate and advise on appropriate legal courses of action to meet Company and business unit needs.
You Are Likely To Succeed If:
3-5 years of experience as a practicing attorney at a law firm or in-house.
You are excited by and highly determined to work on commercial contracts. You have a passion for drafting, negotiating, and redlining and are eager to further develop these skills.
Your attention to detail is stellar.
You have excellent interpersonal and communication skills and enjoy working cross-functionally.
You thrive in the unknown, are motivated to think creatively each day and can handle new areas of responsibility independently.
Experience drafting and negotiating US business contracts is strongly preferred.
Nice to have:
You have a law degree (JD or LLM) from a top law school in the United States, are licensed to practice and a member of good standing of a United States bar, and have the appropriate practical knowledge, skills and abilities acquired through 3-5 years of relevant experience.
This is an exciting opportunity for a top law firm associate or experienced attorney at a high-growth tech or data product company with strong communication skills and impeccable judgment.
What We Offer:
Flexible PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits)
Flexible work schedule
Personal laptop
Health and wellness package
Remote work

title: SAP Data Migration Lead Consultant

ABOUT US
Syniti
is
the
enterprise data partner, empowering anyone who relies on data to make business-critical decisions by delivering data they can trust through a unique combination of intelligent software and experts who deeply understand the role of data in enterprise growth.
Trusted by the Fortune 2000, Syniti helps leading businesses reconfigure the role of enterprise data from afterthought to foundational first step; enabling them to unlock valuable insights that ignite growth, reduce risk, and expand their competitive advantage.

world’s top system integrators .
Headquartered in Boston, Massachusetts with offices in 25 countries around the world, Syniti operates in all global regions and industry verticals, and maintains a 100% client success rate across thousands of complex data projects and initiatives.
The ROLE
We are recruiting talented and motivated individuals to join our team delivering data projects for clients across the globe. As a lead data migration consultant at Syniti, you will be responsible for managing a team of migration consultants on all aspects of data work for a process area/workstream. You will work closely with functional consultants and key customer resources, gathering requirements through workshops, building conversion objects, and driving your team’s value through all data project phases. You will be responsible for making sure that your team uses your data skills and the Syniti data management platform to assess and iterate through design, build, and deployment, ensuring that the highest customer value is derived from your assigned objects. As a lead member of a Syniti Data Migration team, you will execute against the best practices for successful business transformation and become skilled in the strongest platform to meet all of our customer’s needs.
WHAT YOU WILL DO
After an initial training period, a Lead Data Migration Consultant will be expected to:
Demonstrate a strong understanding of Syniti’s Data Migration methodology.
Demonstrate strong proficiency in Syniti’s tools, working to prescribed development standards.
Good understanding of business processes for one or more assigned functional area, and the ability to quickly learn about new areas.
Effectively manage a small team of data migration consultants, to meet assigned responsibilities against the overall project plan.
Demonstrate a strong knowledge of underlying technical data structures and definitions of assigned functional process area.
Develop data migration rules and reports in the Syniti’s tools as per supplied specification.
Evaluate and contribute to ongoing data migration design for assigned process area through data analysis, reporting and collaboration with on-site Syniti and client colleagues.
Create and maintain data load programs.
Maintain related documentation and clearly communicate status to Syniti Team Leadership and customer PMO.
Execution of end-to-end data loads and reconciliations.
Support and mentor junior colleagues.
WHAT IT TAKES
Degree level qualification in Computer Science (or other technology related field).
Experience in ETL / Data Migration / Data Quality / Data Analysis.
Experience managing resources to deliver a collective goal/responsibility.
Functional ERP experience.
Project experience across multiple ERP implementations.
Database experience - SQL Server, Oracle etc.
Customer facing skills.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Willingness to travel according to project requirements up to 100%.
WHAT WE OFFER
Autonomy and Trust:
Trust that you are proficient at what you do. At Syniti, you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, with minimal micromanagement.
Growth Opportunities:
We are growing rapidly, offering you the chance to grow with us, shape our journey, and share in our success story.
Collaborative Support:
We value collaboration and support each other, ensuring you won't stand alone in your endeavors.
Diversity of Stories:
Genuine interest in your unique story and journey. We celebrate individual achievements and want to hear everyone's story.
Recognition:
We appreciate and celebrate individual achievements, acknowledging the contribution of each team member.
Open Organization:
We embrace an open and inclusive culture, where hierarchies are minimized, and access is ensured across the board. Everyone is valued, and ideas are welcomed.

title: Coordenador de laboratório
description:
Sobre nós
A Archroma é uma empresa líder e reconhecida globalmente em produtos químicos especiais, dedicada a criar um mundo mais colorido, sustentável e eficiente. Nossa missão é ser a melhor parceira para nossos clientes, com um profundo comprometimento com inovação, qualidade e sustentabilidade. Com uma rica herança de mais de 100 anos, continuamos a impulsionar a excelência na indústria química. Estamos buscando um Coordenador de Laboratório qualificado e dedicado para se juntar à nossa equipe.
Visão geral da vaga
O Coordenador de Laboratório que buscamos deve ser capaz de construir relacionamentos, ter iniciativa e capacidade de tomada de decisão. Deverá realizar e apoiar testes de aplicação têxtil para avaliar nossos produtos do portfólio, trabalhar em colaboração com a equipe comercial e técnica com o objetivo de uma melhor compreensão das necessidades dos clientes e promoção dos produtos.
Principais responsabilidades
Atuar como responsável técnico pelo laboratório com o regulamento CRQ;
Coordenar as atividades do laboratório para atender às necessidades dos clientes externos e internos em relação ao cumprimento de prazos e qualidade do trabalho;
Coordenar o suporte fornecido pela equipe do laboratório às áreas de vendas e técnica com o objetivo de manter e aumentar a participação de mercado dos nossos produtos;
Gerenciar e registrar todo o trabalho do laboratório, conduzindo-o em todas as etapas;
Liderar e promover treinamentos para a equipe do laboratório e clientes externos;
Manutenção de conceitos e documentos relacionados ao SGQ (ISO);
Manter as instalações e equipamentos do laboratório em pleno funcionamento através da manutenção e calibração dos equipamentos;
Coordenar as reclamações de clientes (QNS) utilizando a ferramenta SAP;
Responsável pela declaração e licenças do exército, polícia federal e polícia civil do laboratório;
Responsável pelo estoque de reagentes e materiais, controlando rotulagem e validade;
Controlar e distribuir amostras padrão de cor;
Alto conhecimento em medições espectrofotométricas e software de colorimetria para diversas aplicações têxteis;
Combinação de tonalidades (cor e branco) em vários artigos e processos têxteis (exaustão, contínuo e impressão);
Desenvolvimento de acabamentos com efeitos especiais em vários artigos e processos têxteis (exaustão e contínuo);
Teste de desempenho de tecidos de acordo com procedimentos específicos;
Preparar relatórios e também verificar relatórios de analistas para testes de análise realizados, a fim de manter registro de mudanças e/ou resultados arquivados;
Assegurar a conformidade dos aspectos legais de acordo com questões de Segurança, Saúde e Meio Ambiente;
Qualificações
Graduação completa em Química;
Desejável: Técnico em Química ou Têxtil;
Habilidade de Trabalho em Equipe;
Habilidades Organizacionais;
Capacidade de trabalhar com prazos;
Inglês intermediário para leitura de processos, escrever e-mails, traduzir métodos e informações técnicas, além de se comunicar com outros laboratórios;
Conhecimento desejável em SAP;
Capacidade de priorizar e lidar com várias tarefas;
Conhecimento de Word, Excel e Power Point;

Live the Ride:
Faça. Feito é melhor que perfeito. Aprendemos com os erros e encaramos desafios como oportunidades de aprendizado.
No Bullshit:
Agir com simplicidade. Somos pessoas práticas, sinceras e gostamos de feedbacks. Sabemos que às vezes vamos errar e contamos com essa transparência para evoluirmos.
Team Play:
Se quer ir rápido, vá sozinho(a). Se quer ir longe, trabalhe em equipe. É sempre possível aprender com as outras pessoas e a colaboração é a chave do sucesso.

O cliente não tem razão, ele é a razão. Nos motivamos a enxergar o impacto do nosso trabalho na vida do cliente, é vendo que melhoramos a vida dele que sabemos que fizemos uma boa entrega.

Ser Software Engineering Manager na Stone significa liderar equipes de engenharia de software, promovendo um ambiente colaborativo e orientado a resultados. É esperado que você atue como facilitador, garantindo que os times tenham clareza de propósito e os recursos necessários para entregar soluções de alta qualidade. Além disso, você será responsável por alinhar as metas técnicas com os objetivos estratégicos da empresa, promovendo o crescimento profissional dos membros da equipe e fomentando uma cultura de aprendizado contínuo. Liderar e desenvolver times de engenharia, com foco em alta performance e crescimento individual através de 1:1s, PDI e avaliação de desempenho;
Liderar um time multidisciplinar com frontend web, backend e mobile (entre 5 a 7 devs);
Participar de etapas de recrutamento em entrevista técnicas, desafio etc;
Buscar conhecimento sobre os planos estratégicos e operacionais da empresa, propagando e conectando direcionamento técnico alinhado a estratégia;
Facilitar a comunicação entre times técnicos e stakeholders, garantindo transparência e alinhamento;
Promover um ambiente de colaboração, segurança psicológica e feedback constante;
Responsável pela definição e acompanhamento dos processos e ritos do time adotando práticas ágeis;

Garantir a construção de estratégias técnicas dos domínios do time, defendendo e promovendo boas práticas de engenharia, padrões de projeto, processos e acordos (Clean Code, TDD, CI/CD, DevSecOps, Documentações);

Participação da definição e acompanhamento de OKRs e métricas técnicas (lead time, estabilidade, cobertura de testes etc.);

Lidar com problemas ambíguos e priorização desafiadora, equilibrando prazo e qualidade;
Ser influente em tomadas de decisões junto ao time em detalhes de soluções; Garantir qualidade, escalabilidade e boas práticas do produto/plataforma;
O que esperamos de você:
Experiência em liderança de times técnicos multidisciplinares com frontend (Mobile e Web) e backend;

Estabelecer, documentar e aplicar políticas de segurança da informação, alinhadas com frameworks como ISO 27001, NIST e LGPD;
Monitorar continuamente o ambiente de TI utilizando ferramentas como Azure Monitor, Microsoft Sentinel, Log Analytics;
Implementar e acompanhar KPIs e métricas de segurança, desempenho e conformidade de TI;

title: Senior NLP/ML Software Engineer
description:
Our US-based client is a fast-growing, mission-driven language technology company developing the next generation of interpretation and multilingual communication platforms. Their goal is to break down language barriers worldwide via cutting-edge speech and language AI powering solutions such as video remote interpretation (VRI), over-the-phone interpretation (OPI), interpreter scheduling, simultaneous interpretation, and more.
They're seeking a Senior Software Engineer with deep expertise in NLP and ML to help build scalable, production-grade language technology systems. This role is ideal for someone passionate about transformer models, audio processing, large-scale data pipelines, and real-world ML deployments.
This is a high-impact role for someone who wants to shape the future of language accessibility and global communication through sophisticated, scalable ML systems. If you're excited to build at the intersection of language, audio, and AI and do it in a real-world product used globally, we'd love to hear from you.
Headquartered in Austin, Texas, with remote teams based in San Francisco, Copenhagen, Manila, and Ireland. The company has consistently achieved Net Promoter Scores (NPS) above 60, reflecting excellent customer satisfaction. The team is collaborative, inclusive, and highly engaged, with strong onboarding and growth support for new hires.
Responsibilities:
Architect, build, and maintain scalable ML-based systems focused on language processing, speech recognition, and real-time communication technologies
Train and fine-tune transformer-based models (e.g., Whisper, wav2vec 2.0, BERT, T5) for tasks such as audio transcription, classification, summarization, and conversational AI
Develop and deploy ML-powered microservices and APIs that integrate tightly with the platform's cloud infrastructure
Build and manage robust data pipelines for multilingual speech and text datasets, including cleaning, augmentation, and validation
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate ML models into production workflows with a strong emphasis on reliability, observability, and user experience
Apply software engineering best practices to assure performance, scalability, and maintainability using secure coding principles, automated unit testing, code reviews, horizontal scaling, vertical scaling, microservice architectures, and continuous integration CI/CD pipelines
Troubleshoot, isolate root causes, and provide innovative solutions in reasonable timeframes
Conduct research to evaluate and adopt emerging ML methods, with a focus on efficient inference, transfer learning, and low-latency deployment
Stay up to date with industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices in software development and AI
REQUIRED EXPERIENCE:
5+ years of hands-on software development experience using Python, Node.js, and TypeScript
Agile development experience and strong communication skills in English (written and verbal)
Solid background in machine learning, with experience in supervised and unsupervised algorithms

title: Data Engineer
description:
About Eightpoint
Eightpoint is an internet technology company specializing in the agile development of products and content that address real-world interests, captivating users and driving significant growth for partners. With offices in the United States and Cayman Islands, Eightpoint collaborates with partners globally on the next generation of user-centric offerings. Our growing ecosystem includes innovative products like Weather Now, a sleek app that delivers real-time forecasts with clarity and ranks among the top three most-used weather apps in the U.S.; Check Heart Rate Now, a quick and easy wellness monitor; and Wave Browser, a powerful and secure way to search the web. Every product we launch is designed to engage users, enhance daily life, and deliver real-world value. Backed by data and driven by a relentless commitment to quality, Eightpoint moves fast, thinks big, and builds digital experiences that people love.
About the Role
We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Data Engineer to enhance and maintain the infrastructure that powers our analytics and data products. In this role, you will be responsible for building and optimizing scalable data pipelines, ingesting data from various sources, and collaborating with teams to ensure the integrity, security, and accessibility of our data ecosystem.
Where You’ll Make an Impact
Enhance and maintain the infrastructure powering our analytics and data products
Ingest new data from files, APIs, and external databases into a centralized data store, ensuring seamless integration and data flow
Continuously monitor, optimize, and troubleshoot data pipelines and infrastructure for performance, scalability, and cost-effectiveness
Work closely with business stakeholders, including Analysts and Data Scientists, to understand data needs and translate business requirements into technical solutions
Implement and enforce data governance policies, ensuring adherence to best practices in data security, integrity, privacy, and regulatory compliance
Contribute to and drive efforts to ensure high data quality across the organization by identifying and resolving issues in data pipelines and workflows
Participate in technical architecture discussions, offering expertise in designing scalable, efficient data systems.
Engage in peer code reviews to maintain high standards of code quality and best practices
Who You Are
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field, or equivalent work experience
3+ years working as a Data Engineer or in a similar technical role with a focus on building and maintaining data infrastructure and pipelines
Experience with AWS (Redshift, RDS) REQUIRED and Google Cloud (BigQuery, Firebase) for managing and working with cloud-based databases and analytics tools
REQUIRED: Proficiency in at least one programming language (Python, C#, Java, etc.) to automate data pipeline workflows
REQUIRED: Familiarity with data pipeline orchestration tools such as dbt and Airflow
Strong knowledge of data warehousing concepts and ELT/ETL best practices
REQUIRED: Familiarity with source version control systems
REQUIRED: Strong SQL knowledge

title: Scrum Master Sr
description:
Job Description
A Genesis Consulting tem uma oportunidade imediata para Scrum Masters experientes e com verdadeira paixão por crescimento profissional e transformação de negócios através do lean-agile. Nossos clientes são alguns dos principais líderes mundiais em diferentes indústrias e o candidato fará parte de projetos desafiadores para construir e apoiar soluções técnicas para suas necessidades. Junte-se ao nosso time e seja um agente facilitador de resultados de negócios através dos conceitos de Business Agility, Lean, Agile, Kanban e SAFe.
O Scrum Master trabalhará com equipes de entrega ágil para aprimorar e habilitar o desempenho de nível de equipe e entrega de valor usando o Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe).
Duties and Responsibilities:
· Coach de equipes referentes aos valores e princípios lean-agile;
· Facilitar cerimônias ágeis no nível de time (Retrospectiva, Daily Scrum, Sprint Review, Sprint Planning, Refining), garantindo o entendimento e engajamento total da equipe em tais;
· Promover o mindset e práticas de melhoria contínua para as equipes ágeis;
· Integração das melhores práticas e padrões de agilidade em um contexto altamente regulado;
· Fomentar o senso de responsabilidade compartilhada nas equipes e stakeholders;
· Facilitar a resolução de ou impedimentos existentes para os times;
· Gerenciar interdependências entre equipes ágeis;
· Trabalhar com Product Owners para apoiar o planejamento de Curto Prazo e evolução da definição/priorização do Backlog de produto do time;
· Proteger as equipes de interferências externas que possam impactar princípios de agilidade, produtividade da equipe e/ou estágio de formação da equipe;
· Participar e auxiliar na facilitação de todas as cerimônias em um ambiente ágil escalado (SAFe Essential);
Minimum Qualifications/Experience:
· Experiência comprovada como Scrum Master/Agile Master (conhecimento será testado);
· Experiência em ambiente regido pelas cerimônias do SAFe
· Vivência de TI em projetos de desenvolvimento de soluções complexas e de alta disponibilidade
· Experiência com diferentes modelos, métricas e cerimônias no nível de equipe ágil
· Experiência com ferramentas de gerenciamento de trabalho ágil (Jira), incluindo configuração, planejamento e relatórios
· Capacidade promover agilidade em diferentes cenários sendo responsável por garantir que as equipes entendam e operem de acordo com os valores e princípios de agilidade
· Conhecimento em outros métodos e práticas ágeis além do Scrum
Minimum Education:
· Bachelor’s Degree
Required Certifications:
· Possuir certificação KMP, PSPM e MGT 3.0
· Possuir certificação SAFe (plus)
Other:
· English (plus)

title: ESPECIALISTA PRODUCT OWNER (PO)
description:
DESCRIÇÃO DA VAGA:
Nossa tecnologia dita o ritmo do mercado. Afinal, 25% do PIB brasileiro passa pelos softwares presentes em mais de 40 mil empresas clientes da TOTVS.
Para que isso aconteça precisamos ser ágeis, pois as coisas aqui acontecem em uma velocidade acima da média. No nosso dia-dia, aprendemos muito e muito rápido, em um ambiente leve, divertido e desafiador.
Nosso time de tecnologia tem a ousadia para colocar todo esse aprendizado e conhecimento em prática. Assim, transformando todos os setores da economia por meio da tecnologia. Topa esse desafio?
#ouseetransforme e #sejaTOTVER
MISSÃO:
Buscamos um(a) Product Owner para atuar na estruturação, evolução e entrega de produtos voltados para Gestão de Riscos de Compliance e Governança, garantindo aderência regulatória e operacional, com foco especial em lei SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley) e matriz de Segregação de Funções (SoD).
Este(a) profissional atuará como ponte estratégica entre áreas de negócio (Compliance, Auditoria, Governança) e times técnicos (engenharia de dados, segurança, sistemas corporativos), assegurando alinhamento de prioridades, clareza de escopo e entrega contínua de valor, especialmente no que se refere à conformidade normativa e mitigação de riscos.
O QUE ESPERAMOS DE VOCÊ:
Entender as necessidades de governança, risco e compliance, traduzindo-as em demandas claras para os times técnicos.
Gerenciar o backlog do produto, priorizando entregas de alto impacto estratégico.
Atuar na definição e acompanhamento do roadmap de soluções para controle de acessos, matriz SoD, segregação de funções e auditoria de conformidade.
Co-criar soluções técnicas com áreas de engenharia, segurança e dados, garantindo a aderência às exigências da lei SOX e boas práticas de compliance.
Monitorar indicadores de desempenho (KPIs) do produto
Garantir a documentação robusta de processos, decisões e auditorias, promovendo comunicação clara e alinhamento organizacional.
Conduzir cerimônias ágeis (Scrum/Kanban), apoiando o time no entendimento do contexto de negócios regulatórios.
O QUE SERIA LEGAL SE VOCÊ TIVESSE:
Certificações (CSPO, PSPO)
Experiência com produtos voltados para gestão de acessos, identidade digital ou auditoria.
Formação em Administração, Engenharia, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas relacionadas a negócios e tecnologia.
Familiaridade com frameworks de compliance como COBIT, ITGC, ISO 27001 ou LGPD.
INFORMAÇÕES ADICIONAIS:

title: Engagement Leader
description:
This role can be based in Sao Paulo OR Rio de Janeiro
Please submit a resume in English
Heidrick Consulting Brazil
You would be part of our Consulting Practice in Brazil. At Heidrick Consulting, we work with Senior Leadership, Executive Teams, and Boards, covering major national and multi-national companies across all industry sectors in Brazil and Latin America.
You will be joining a growing, dynamic team, and in this role as a Consultant, you will continue to learn and deepen your consulting skills by working on various projects. Your contributions will expose you to senior leaders across a variety of industries and geographies.
Primary Responsibilities
The main purpose of the Consultant is to develop consulting solutions as part of client engagements, to write proposals and support business development activities, to act as engagement manager on specific projects and to support Principals and Partners in their delivery.
You will begin to lead, manage, and own problem-solving efforts on a large portion of a client engagement or to lead on smaller engagements. Specifically, you will be responsible for identifying issues, forming hypotheses, designing and conducting analysis, and then synthesizing conclusions into recommendations. Throughout an engagement, you will be involved in discussions and presentations with senior client leadership.
Role Responsibilities:
Gathering, analyzing and interpreting data and information; generating insights from analyses.
Preparing and presenting information and insights in an impactful and compelling way to help drive client insights and engagement delivery.
Delivering a range of consulting solutions, preparing reports and other deliverables that meet client needs.
Facilitating and working with client teams with a client first mindset, managing and designing client sessions.
Ensuring work is “client ready” (e.g., error free, aligned with expectations, ready to be shared with client) and actively managing expectations with the team.
Planning and prioritizing work ensuring team deadlines and quality standards are met.
Contributing to proposals (e.g., supporting content development of project design and approaches and case studies) and mobilizing ‘won’ initiatives.
Building and sharing reusable, client ready materials, insights (including case studies) and project learnings.
Building and maintaining relationships with colleagues across Heidrick & Struggles in Brazil and globally.
Contributing to thought leadership and supporting the development of product, tools, and methodologies.
Involving yourself in internal initiatives, supporting ongoing improvements of business and employee experience; many initiatives are global and will provide an opportunity to build a global network.
The Ideal Candidate:
Passionate and Engaged:
Will bring a genuine enthusiasm for serving a broad variety of organizations on strategic people and talent topics, including leadership and team development, succession planning, Board effectiveness and organizational culture change.
Self-Driven and Inquisitive:
Exhibits a strong desire to continuously learn and explore new topics relevant to client organizations and industry sectors.
Entrepreneurial Spirit and Team Player:
Possesses an entrepreneurial mindset with a keen interest in contributing to a growing business unit. Brings innovative ideas and a proactive approach to delivering on agreed deadlines and client deliverables.
Minimum Role Qualifications
2-4 years of professional work experience, with a minimum of 2 years in a management, strategy or leadership consulting environment.
An undergraduate degree is required.
Experience working directly with clients in a professional service, team-based environment.
Ability to drive workload independently within a broader team project setting.
Ability to manage time effectively, being comfortable with handling multiple priorities and being able to adapt to changing business needs.
Demonstrated advanced proficiency in PowerPoint, Excel and Word; easily able to adopt new technologies and software.
Excellent communication skills; writing skills with a proven track record of success preparing concise and compelling reports and other client ready deliverables.
Ability to communicate, both verbally and in writing, in English and Portuguese. Other languages are a plus.
Willingness to travel locally and globally as required.

title: Network Engineer Microwave
description:
ZTE Brazil is looking for a detail-oriented and proactive Network Engineer (Microwave) to support project, commissioning, performance monitoring, and process standardization across telecom deployment and operations projects. This role will interface with clients such as TIM, Claro, and Vivo, ensuring compliance with internal methodologies and contractual obligations.
Key Responsibilities:
Use specialized software tools to simulate and optimize circuit performance, ensuring that components operate within the desired frequency range with high efficiency and low noise.
Determining the appropriate antenna type, calculating radiation patterns, and optimizing antenna impedance to maximize signal transmission and reception.
Develop complete microwave systems, integrating different components to meet specific performance requirements. This could involve designing a microwave communication link between two remote locations, considering factors such as distance, frequency allocation, and interference mitigation.
Use test equipment like network analyzers, spectrum analyzers, and oscilloscopes to measure the performance of microwave components. They verify parameters such as gain, bandwidth, return loss, and phase noise to ensure that components meet design specifications.
Conduct tests on entire microwave systems in laboratory and field environments. This includes evaluating system performance under different operating conditions, such as varying temperatures, humidity levels, and signal strengths. They also perform interference testing to ensure the system can operate in a crowded electromagnetic environment without degradation.
Keep abreast of the latest research and technological advancements in microwave engineering, such as new materials, manufacturing techniques, and communication protocols.
Address complex technical problems in microwave systems, such as minimizing signal distortion, improving power efficiency, or reducing electromagnetic interference.
Requirements:
Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Telecommunications, IT or related fields.
Minimum of 5 years’ experience in Microwave Network Project, preferably within telecom or tech companies.
Strong understanding of project management tools, commissioning, prediction and executive reporting.
Previous experience working in multicultural environments or with Chinese organizations is a plus.
Advanced English is mandatory; Mandarin or Spanish is a differential.
Proficiency in Microsoft Project, advanced Excel, Power BI, Jira/Confluence.
Behavioral Competencies:
Work closely with cross - functional teams.
Highly organized, detail-oriented, and methodical.
Strong interpersonal communication and collaborative mindset.
Ability to work under pressure and manage competing priorities.
Initiative and ownership over assigned responsibilities.
Differentials:
Hands-on experience with field operations.
Prior knowledge of telecom vendors ecosystem and operational model in Brazil.

HCLTech Brazil is hiring Digital Verification (DV) Engineers to develop SoCs and IPs in conjunction with one of the largest semiconductor companies, based on North America and leader in the automotive, power management and IoT segments ! Come to be part of this challenge with us!
Requirements and Activities:
The candidates must have 5+ years of experience and the expectations for the role are the following:​
Advanced English
Versed in SystemVerilog, C, Assembly and OOP-based languages (SV-UVM)​
Experience in creating verification plans based on design specification​
Experience in test case development, simulation and debugging with standard tools (Xcelium, VCS or QuestaSim)​
Experience with code coverage analysis (functional coverage is a plus)​
Basic knowledge in SystemVerilog Assertions (SVA)​
Desirable experience in test bench development (drivers, monitors, agents, scoreboards, etc)​
Experience with serial protocols like SPI, I2C, USB, UART, USART, CAN, Ethernet or others​
Familiar with architecture of ARM Cortex processors (RISCV is a plus)​
Ability to develop scripts for verification automation (shell, tcl, perl, python, etc)​
Basic knowledge about version control systems (Git, DesignSync, Perforce, Subversion, Clearcase, etc)​
Experience in gate-level simulations is a plus​
Basic knowledge about Formal verification is a plus​
Background in verification of MIPI standard interfaces is a plus​
Background in verification of Video Encoder and Decoder is a plus.​
HCLTech is a worldwide company, present in more than 60 countries and is a well recognized partner to over 50% of the Global 500 companies. HCLTech is a Top Employer in 28 countries, and is present in Brazil for more than 15 years. The HCLTech division of Engineering and R&D Services is partnering with our customers to enable technologies and innovation in different state-of-art applications.​
HCLTech Semiconductor Design Center in Brazil is engaged with multiple worldwide partners, helping our customers in different areas of Semiconductor Engineering, including Architecture, Design, Verification, Physical Design, DFT, Analog and Custom Layout, and Post-Si validation. The Brazil Semiconductor Design Center has more than 26 years of experience in developing microcontrollers and designing highly complex IPs (Digital and Analog) for different applications, in different technology nodes.​

title: Engenheiro de Aplicação e Vendas
description:
Descrição
Sobre a NARI Brasil
A NARI Brasil é uma empresa integrante ao NARI Group Corporation, líder no fornecimento de equipamentos para o setor de energia elétrica na China. Fundado em 1973, o grupo NARI dedica-se a oferecer tecnologias de ponta.
Desde sua fundação no Brasil em 2013 com suas operações em Sorocaba-SP, a NARI Brasil tem se destacado no desenvolvimento e comercialização de sistemas de controle e proteção de subestações, com foco em soluções inovadoras e de alta qualidade.
Oportunidade
Atualmente, estamos em fase de expansão do nosso departamento Comercial e buscamos profissionais com experiência em Vendas e Aplicação para fortalecer o time. Se você possui experiência no setor e se identifica com nossa missão, convidamos você a conhecer os requisitos detalhados abaixo e explorar essa oportunidade!
Requisitos

  • Superior Completo em Engenharia Elétrica ou correlatos
  • Vivência, conhecimentos sólidos e estar atualizado sobre conceitos e regras do mercado de Energia e Subestações no Brasil e seus principais clientes, Procedimentos de rede do ONS, ANEEL.
  • Experiência anterior com Aplicação e/ou Vendas nos segmentos de Energia e sistemas de proteção e controle de subestações (SPCS)
  • Inglês Intermediário à Avançado para conversação diária;
  • Disponibilidade para atuação hibrida em São Paulo e viagens em visitas à Clientes.
    Descrição das Atividades
  • Identificar as oportunidades-alvo para projetos e soluções NARI com novos clientes por criar valor agregado e garantir um resultado bem-sucedido das transações, contratos e propostas através do uso eficaz de técnicas de vendas.
  • Elaboração de propostas comerciais e técnicas, desde o recebimento da solicitação ao envio da resposta e documentação consolidada, envolvendo a mitigação dos riscos comerciais, jurídicos, técnicos e operacionais juntos as principais áreas, precificação, análise do fluxo de caixa e levantamento de requisitos.
  • Participar nas negociações com o cliente sobre aspectos gerais, contratual e comercial do conteúdo da proposta
  • Avaliar e analisar leads por meio de critérios de triagem aplicados para converter de leads em prospects e oportunidades. Visita a todos os potenciais clientes utilizando as redes estabelecidas.
    Inscreva-se para essa oportunidade!

title: Java Engineer - Work from home

As a

Advocate for improvements to product quality, security, and performance.

Craft code that meets our internal standards for style, maintainability, and best practices for a high-scale web environment.
Conduct architecture reviews and code reviews within our Code Review Guidelines and enforce best practices.
Keep up to date with emerging trends in software architecture and cloud infrastructure.
Recognize impediments to our efficiency as a team ("technical debt"), propose and implement solutions.
Design and architect microservices-based solutions using Java and related technologies.
Advocate for improvements to product quality, security, and performance.
This would make you the ideal candidate
Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
7+ Years of experience working in Software Development.
5+ Years of experience working with Java.
3+ Years of experience working in architectural design or working as a solutions architect.
3+ Years of experience working with Distributed systems.
3+ Years of experience working with Microservices.
3+ Years of experience working with SQL (recent experience).
1+ Years of experience working with Kotlin.
Knowledge of testing and security fundamentals, concurrency and transactional common issues and events.
Advanced English Level is required for this role as you will work with US clients. Effective communication in English is essential to deliver the best solutions to our clients and expand your horizons.

1. Let’s chat about your experience!
2. Impress our recruiters, and you’ll move on to a technical interview with our top developers.

title: Salesforce Developer
description:
About the job
Why join Safeguard Global?
We want to help you
“Work in Any Way ” - that makes time for family, commitments, and life outside, so that you can have the best of both worlds. When you own what you do and are driven to deliver, you have the flexibility to decide where and how you work.
The role in a nutshell :
As a Salesforce Developer, you will design, build, and maintain custom solutions on the Salesforce platform, leveraging tools like Flows, Apex, Visualforce, and Lightning Components. You'll collaborate with stakeholders to translate business requirements into technical solutions, integrate Salesforce with external systems, and ensure high-quality development through testing and best practices.
How you will make a difference:
Design, develop, and maintain custom solutions on the Salesforce platform using Flows, Apex, Visualforce, Lightning Components (Aura and LWC), related applications and other Salesforce technologies.
Collaborate with business stakeholders, admins, architects and project managers to gather and understand requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
Customize and configure Salesforce to meet business needs, including creating custom objects, fields, workflows, validation rules, process automation, reports and dashboards.
Integrate Salesforce with other systems using REST, SOAP, and other APIs.
Participate in refining user stories, code reviews, perform unit testing, integration and functional testing; and follow best practices for development and deployment.
Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues related to Salesforce implementations and integrations.
Keep up to date with Salesforce releases, new features, and best practices to continuously improve the platform.
Provide technical guidance and support to other team members and departments as needed.
Document technical solutions, processes, and development work for future reference.
What will give you an advantage:
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
5+ years of hands-on experience in Salesforce development and administration.
Experience in Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) process, coding standards, change control, and version management
Proficient in Flows, Apex, Visualforce, Lightning Components (Aura and LWC), SOQL, and SOSL.
Experience with Salesforce configuration, including flows, validation rules, and process automation; and integration tools and techniques, including REST and SOAP APIs.
Strong understanding of Salesforce security, including roles, profiles, and sharing rules.
Familiarity with Agile/Scrum development methodologies.
Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work both independently and in a team environment.
Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate technical concepts into business-friendly language.
Salesforce certifications (e.g., Salesforce Certified Platform Developer I or II, Salesforce Certified Administrator) are a plus
Who we are and what we do:
Safeguard Global is....Global! With offices worldwide, we help 1500+ companies hire, manage, and pay employees in 170+ countries. It's all about people! Join us to meet diverse folks, explore new cultures, and connect with amazing folks from around the globe.
Our Global Benefits
Autonomy & Flexibility (Work in Any Way): Be supported with as much flexibility as possible.
Bonding Leave: Enjoy paid leave to bond with your new family member.
2 Charitable Days: Contribute to causes you believe in.
Reward & Recognition Program: Be rewarded for your success and championing our values.
Corporate bonus/SIP: All Guardians are eligible for our annual bonus scheme or sales incentive plan.
Why become a Guardian:
International Environment: Grow your network internationally and collaborate across the world. Interact, discover cultures, and tap into local expertise.
Our Culture: We emphasize the people factor in everything we do. Our nurturing culture ensures your ideas reach our leaders and your contributions get the recognition they deserve.
Learning: We support your continuous growth by providing access to 2 learning platforms, where you can learn at your own pace.
Welcome to the Future of Work!
At Safeguard Global, we are committed to providing an environment of mutual respect where equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants and Guardians.

title: Email Marketing Specialist

As a
Data & Telemetry Architect , you will design and implement end-to-end observability and telemetry solutions that enhance system reliability, traceability, and performance monitoring across cloud and hybrid environments. This role combines hands-on engineering with architectural foresight to ensure that infrastructure and applications are fully instrumented and observable from day one. The expert will leverage leading platforms to deliver actionable insights from logs, metrics, and traces that support real-time troubleshooting, proactive monitoring, and data-driven operations.
This role collaborates closely with infrastructure teams, platform engineers, and application developers to embed telemetry best practices and support resilient, scalable digital platforms.
How your day-to-day work will look like:
Design, implement, and maintain scalable telemetry architectures that support distributed applications across multi-cloud (Azure, AWS, GCP) and hybrid cloud environments.
Build and optimize observability pipelines using tools like Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, potentially integrating with or leveraging concepts from platforms like Splunk, ELK Stack (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana), Grafana, and OpenTelemetry standards to collect, aggregate, and route data.
Develop structured logging and tracing strategies for microservices and distributed systems to support end-to-end visibility and root-cause analysis.
Configure data connectors and ingestion pathways to bring logs, metrics, and traces from various sources (including cloud provider native logs, application telemetry, and security tool outputs) into a centralized log aggregation platform, likely utilizing Microsoft Sentinel / Log Analytics workspace.
Help implement real-time alerting and dashboards (e.g., using Azure Monitor Workbooks or Sentinel Workbooks) for SRE, DevOps, and development teams to monitor key system health metrics, performance indicators, and security signals.
Standardize telemetry data collection across application tiers, containers, VMs, and cloud-native components using open standards where applicable.
Partner with development teams to embed observability into the software delivery lifecycle, supporting continuous improvement and faster incident resolution ("shift left").
Support log ingestion design, parsing rules, index strategy, and storage optimization for large-scale telemetry systems, balancing visibility needs with cost considerations.
Evaluate, integrate, and tune third-party observability platforms and logging agents, e.g. Vector, to enhance data collection capabilities.
Conduct telemetry health checks, identify data blind spots, and lead remediation strategies to ensure comprehensive coverage.
Collaborate closely with cloud security operations to integrate observability data and insights with tools like Wiz, Microsoft Defender for Cloud, and Microsoft Sentinel, improving unified visibility, contextual risk analysis, and threat hunting capabilities related to system behavior.
Champion the automation of observability configurations and policy enforcement using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Terraform and ARM templates.
Provide documentation, training, and support for internal teams on telemetry use cases and dashboards.
Ensure observability solutions meet relevant regulatory and compliance requirements by providing necessary audit trails and reporting capabilities.
This would make you the ideal candidate:
Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
Proven experience in designing, implementing, and managing complex observability solutions in cloud environments.
Hands-on experience with logging and monitoring services across multiple cloud platforms (Microsoft Azure, AWS, GCP).
Deep expertise with Azure Monitor and Log Analytics.
Proficiency in querying large datasets using Kusto Query Language (KQL) for analysis, reporting, and alerting.
Experience with structured logging, tracing, and monitoring strategies for distributed systems and microservices.
Experience with configuring data collection, including agents, diagnostic settings, and ingestion pipelines.
Experience building dashboards and visualizations for technical and security teams.
Proven expertise with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools like Terraform or ARM templates for automating observability deployment and configuration.
Understanding of CI/CD pipelines and the principles of integrating monitoring and security checks ("shift left").
Familiarity with scripting and automation for data pipeline configuration (e.g., Python, Bash, Ansible).
Experience with various logging/telemetry agents and platforms beyond Azure-native, such as Splunk, ELK, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, or specific agents like Vector.
Experience implementing structured logging in modern programming environments (e.g., .NET, Java, Python).
Solid understanding of SLAs, SLOs, and system reliability metrics as part of SRE practices.

Excellent stakeholder communication and collaboration skills, particularly in cross-functional, DevOps-centric environments.

Experience supporting security investigations or threat hunting efforts with observability data.
